inspectedLocal.caption: Clevedon Pier, from the seafront, near sunset.
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2008 original individually inspected: full eight-arch slender dark iron pier silhouette, continuous flat deck/benches, spherical lamps at support stations, raised central pagoda and two low side shelters. Backlit view does not resolve fine material colors.

inspectedLocal.caption: Clevedon Pier from Toll House, showing boards and seating.
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2007 original individually inspected: grey longitudinal planks, full-length timber seats/backrests, dark tapered lamps with cream globe/cage; two low green glazed shelters flank raised pagoda on broad angled head. Central upper room above open lower structure and stair; concrete landing stage is separate below.

inspectedLocal.caption: Clevedon Pier
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2009 original individually inspected: eight slender repeated arched spans with radiating struts and double raked trestles/cross ties, teal side girder, grey weathered benches/deck; piers pass into water, not eight solid masonry arches. Own shore abutment separate from rock and neighboring buildings.

inspectedLocal.caption: The pavilion at the end of Clevedon Pier
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2008 original individually inspected: two-storey central green/cream pavilion, upper glazed room with amber clerestory, white ornamental wraparound balcony and diagonal external stair, curved flared four-sided roof/lower crown and pyramidal cap/vane. Lower stair to landing stage remains an actual void.

inspectedLocal.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: paired raked steel rails and riveted connecting plate above rounded cast-concrete/iron foundation foot visible at low tide. Rust/fastener distribution simplified, not a structural survey.

inspectedLocal.caption: View of support structure from end of Pier
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: continuous teal flat side girder with repeated vertical stiffeners, longitudinal weathered timber bench backs and dark raked/cross-braced trestles. Distant tollhouse and neighboring hotel remain distinct.

inspectedLocal.caption: North bench towards the toll house.
inspectedLocal.sourceFamily: commons:clevedon pier, view towards the renovation of the royal hotel.jpg
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: tapered black lamp, cream globe with black vertical cage and crest, grey long plank deck/bench with small varied brass plaques. Actual plaque names not copied.

inspectedLocal.caption: North View of Clevedon Pier from nearby hill, Somerset, England
inspectedLocal.inspection: 2013 original individually inspected: long open trestle supports, wider head on closely spaced vertical columns and angled lower concrete landing stage/fender posts. Low tide gives relative scale, not bathymetric depths.

remoteSupplement.inspection: 2009 supplementary original individually inspected: small narrow rough sandstone tollhouse with roll strings, two-storey rectangular body, chamfered landward end, taller crenellated corner turret, thin white transomed rectangular windows and rock-faced lower foundation. Neighbouring larger gabled hotel is excluded; vegetation/rock are not building geometry.
